verdict.rationale: Agent-building platforms can plausibly ship AI-assisted authoring, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no built-in AI that generates or improves prompts, flows, or test cases from a description. Agent Builder is described only as a no-code browser prototyping tool. LLM-driven simulations and judges evaluate agents rather than author them. The coding-agent support (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, llms.txt) relies on external AI, not the platform's own.
